## Hardware

| Connect... |   | ...to... | ...using |
|:-----------|:-:|:---------|:---------|
Monitor | &rarr; | Raspberry Pi | HDMI
Monitor | &rarr; | Raspberry Pi | USB, white port
Audio interface | &rarr; | Raspberry Pi | USB, blue port
Audio interface **MIDI IN** | &rarr; | Keyboard **MIDI OUT** | MIDI cable
Computer keyboard / mouse | &rarr; | Raspberry Pi | USB, white first, then blue
Raspberry Pi | &rarr; | AC power |
MIDI Keyboard | &rarr; | AC power |

: Virtual pipe organ on Raspberry Pi hardware setup

## Software

1. Boot Raspberry Pi
2. Turn on keyboard
3. Launch GrandOrgue

## Troubleshooting

If you are not getting sound:

1. Verify the correct [audio output](software.qmd#audio) is selected
2. If using an audio interface, turn the **MIX** knob fully clockwise to PS to only hear audio from GrandOrgue. If this is set to IN, nothing will be heard.
3. Toggle any monitor switches to ensure nothing is muted. In my case, the one monitor button had to be out.

[^1]: Be sure to connect **MIDI OUT** from the keyboard or organ to **MIDI IN** on the audio interface.
